text: The graph is not a page but a place: one page per place (product id, entity, or technical map key) with the questions (outage, impact, path, access) as modes of that page and its sides as tabs (links, errors, work, code); the map is only a navigator with a small pick card that opens the place. Chosen because the old /graph carried 21 URL params, 16 panel kinds in one aside and up to 17 toolbar pills, and the bar is the foundation's 'one key: a place' (D116/D118). The old /graph stays beside it until the new pages replace it; nothing in src/core changed.
